mrmousenavigation.config.title: [MR] Mouse Navigation
mrmousenavigation.config.screen_back.too: Allows Mouse 4 to close screens or return to previous menus.
Allows Mouse 5 to return forward into submenus you backed out of.
mrmousenavigation.config.books.tooltip: Allows Mouse 4 / 5 to turn pages in written books and lecterns.
mrmousenavigation.config.recipe_book.too: Allows Mouse 4 / 5 to flip recipe book pages.
mrmousenavigation.config.creative_tabs.t: Allows Mouse 4 / 5 to cycle creative inventory item tabs.
mrmousenavigation.config.advancements.to: Allows Mouse 4 / 5 to cycle advancement tabs.
mrmousenavigation.config.chat_history.to: Allows Mouse 4 / 5 to cycle previous / next sent chat messages.
mrmousenavigation.config.chat_middle_cli: Allows middle mouse button (wheel click) to send messages in chat.
mrmousenavigation.config.sound.tooltip: Plays a soft click sound when performing a navigation action.
